questions.question: Who directed Jackie Brown (1997), starring Pam Grier?
questions.note: Adapted from Elmore Leonard’s Rum Punch; his follow-up to Pulp Fiction.

questions.question: Who directed Forrest Gump and Cast Away?
questions.note: He also made Back to the Future and Who Framed Roger Rabbit.

questions.question: Who directed the 1994 Arnold Schwarzenegger spy comedy True Lies?
questions.note: Between The Abyss and Titanic; Jamie Lee Curtis co-stars.

questions.question: Who directed the 2005 King Kong remake after finishing the Lord of the Rings?
questions.note: Naomi Watts, Jack Black, and Andy Serkis as Kong.

questions.question: Who directed Memento (2000) and The Prestige (2006)?
questions.note: The Prestige stars Bale and Jackman as rival magicians; he made The Dark Knight in between.

questions.question: Who directed Gladiator?
questions.note: Also Blade Runner, Alien, and The Martian.

questions.question: Who directed Signs (2002) and The Village (2004)?
questions.note: Mel Gibson in the cornfield; then a 19th-century-looking creature tale.

questions.question: Who directed the Oscar-winning animated film Spirited Away?
questions.note: Studio Ghibli, 2001 — still Ghibli’s best-known film outside Japan.

questions.question: Who wrote and directed Us (2019), about a family attacked by their doubles?
questions.note: His second feature, after Get Out. The doubles are the Tethered.

questions.question: Who directed Lady Bird (2017) and the 2019 adaptation of Little Women?
questions.note: Saoirse Ronan stars in both. Gerwig later made Barbie.
